title: Battle of Pressburg
description:
The **Battle of Pressburg** (now Bratislava) took place in 907 AD, when the Magyar (Hungarian) forces decisively defeated the Bavarian army near the city.

This battle marked a significant turning point in Central European history. The Magyar victory ended Bavarian expansion eastward and established Hungarian control over the Carpathian Basin, which would last for over a millennium.

The battle also led to the decline of Great Moravia, an early Slavic state. Pressburg/Bratislava would later become a major city of the Kingdom of Hungary and served as its capital from 1536 to 1783.
